The father spoke to his son: "Hear my words. Guard the cattle and the sheep. Do not steal the cattle of another. Whoever seeks fame, let him be good. Death comes to men. Do not become afraid, my son!" He heard them, and said: "I shall do so." He became great, and his name became famous.
